title: Product pair coordinate equivalence
statement: For a type $\Omega$ and a natural number $n$, the pairs of functions $u,v:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega$ are in bijection with functions $z:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega\times\Omega$, by sending $(u,v)$ to the function $i\mapsto(u(i),v(i))$.
